raw_text: BREAKING: Nepal and China have signed a framework agreement for a trans-Himalayan railway connecting Kerung (Tibet) to Kathmandu. Estimated cost USD 3.5 billion with Chinese financing. Indian strategic analysts concerned about dual-use potential — railway could enable rapid military logistics to the India-Nepal border. Major shift in regional dynamics.
clean_text: Nepal-China framework agreement for trans-Himalayan railway Kerung to Kathmandu signed. USD 3.5B with Chinese financing. India concerned about dual-use military potential.
